memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in all activities of daily living; works as a bank clerk; walks about 2 km each day.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 4/5 (negative screen).
falls: no falls in the last 12 months; gait normal; timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds (within normal limits).
medicines: 0 regular; will start cetirizine 10 mg HS, fluticasone nasal spray one spray each nostril OD, montelukast 10 mg HS for allergic rhinitis and cholecalciferol 60 000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks then 1000 IU OD for vitamin D deficiency.
mood: reports good mood; denies anxiety or depression.
carers: mother, Mrs. Lakshmi, provides occasional support.
goal: "I want to stay symptom‑free and keep my energy up for work."
